title: rosa sylvestris var. subatrata
intro: Rosa sylvestris var. subatrata, commonly known as the Wild Strawberry Rose, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and protecting against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Rosa sylvestris var. subatrata include its ability to calm the nervous system, promote sleep, and act as an antimicrobial agent, making it a potential natural remedy for various health concerns. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a subject of interest in traditional medicine and phytotherapy.
